guides.intro: What a Shadow priest presses from level 1 to 60, stage by stage, as the trainer and the talent tree hand you new buttons. Shadow levels on a small mana budget: one damage-over-time spell, **Mind Blast** on cooldown, and the wand for everything else until **Mind Flay** arrives at 20. The spec comes alive at 40 with **Shadowform**. Each stage lists the full priority, so you can jump in at your level.

stages.title: Smite, until you own a wand
stages.change: **Smite** is your only attack. Buy or beg a wand as early as you can.
press: Once you own a wand: wand the mob down instead. It costs no mana, and it is how a priest levels until 20.
notes: Keep **Power Word: Fortitude** on yourself at all times, from here to 60.
The fight lab assumes a wand from level 1 and never casts **Smite**, so these levels are not simulated as you will play them.

stages.title: Shadow Word: Pain
stages.change: **Shadow Word: Pain** at the pull, then the wand. One cast per mob.
press: Wand until the mob is dead.
notes: **Power Word: Shield** (6): cast it before a pull you start below half your health, not every pull.
**Renew** (8) heals you between fights for less mana than **Lesser Heal**.
Stop casting **Smite**. The tuned rotation never uses it: the wand is free and the mana buys more as **Shadow Word: Pain**.

stages.title: Mind Blast, and talents begin
stages.change: **Mind Blast** whenever it is ready. Talent points start with **Spirit Tap**.
press: Wand between casts, and to finish.
stages.if_hurt: **Power Word: Shield** before a pull you start below half your health.
notes: **Spirit Tap** (10-14) returns mana after every kill. It is why you rarely drink.
**Inner Fire** (12) joins **Power Word: Fortitude** as a buff you always keep up.
**Psychic Scream** (14): when a mob is on you and you are below 40% of your health, fear it and heal.
**Starshards** (10) and **Holy Fire** (20) are not part of the Shadow rotation.

stages.title: Mind Flay
stages.change: **Mind Flay** (talent) replaces most of your wanding: a channel that also slows the mob.
press: **Mind Flay** in between. It slows the mob while you channel.
Your wand finishes a mob with a hit or two left.
stages.if_hurt: Below a third of your health: **Flash Heal**. **Psychic Scream** if a mob is on you and you are below 40%. **Power Word: Shield** before a pull you start below half your health.
notes: **Devouring Plague** (20): leave it off your bar. The tuned rotation never casts it: it costs too much mana for what it does before the mob dies.
**Improved Mind Blast** (24, 31-34) shortens the cooldown, so **Mind Blast** comes round more often as you level.

stages.title: Shadow Word: Death
stages.change: **Shadow Word: Death**, an instant finisher. With **Early Demise** at 35 it is for any mob below 20% health.
press: **Shadow Word: Death** when one cast will kill the mob.
Your wand finishes a mob with a hit or two left.
stages.if_hurt: Below a third of your health: **Flash Heal**. **Psychic Scream** if a mob is on you and you are below 40%. **Power Word: Shield** before a pull you start below half your health.
notes: **Early Demise** (35) lets you cast **Shadow Word: Death** on any mob below 20% of its health, not only for the killing blow.
**Shadow Word: Death** hurts you if it does not kill. Keep it for the finish.

stages.title: Vampiric Embrace, then Shadowform
stages.change: **Vampiric Embrace** (talent, 39) opens the pull and heals you as you deal damage. **Shadowform** (talent, 40) stays on for good.
press: Pull with the instants: **Vampiric Embrace** when it is ready, then **Shadow Word: Pain**.
**Shadow Word: Death** whenever the mob is below 20% of its health, or when one cast will kill it.
Your wand finishes a mob with a hit or two left.
stages.if_hurt: **Psychic Scream** if a mob is on you and you are below 40% of your health. At 39, before Shadowform, a **Flash Heal** below a third.
notes: **Shadowform** at 40 is the biggest jump of the whole climb: the fight lab's time per kill drops by more than a third. Never leave it.
In **Shadowform** you cannot cast Holy spells. Eat or bandage between fights instead of healing yourself.
The remaining points go to Discipline for mana: **Twin Disciplines** (45-49), **Mental Strength** (53-55) and **Meditation** (58-60).

between: Drink only when you are below about 15% of your mana. **Spirit Tap** and the wand keep you going.
Eat when you are below 40% of your health. Before **Shadowform**, a **Renew** on yourself does the same for a little mana.
Recast **Power Word: Fortitude** and **Inner Fire** when they run out.
Visit the trainer every even level, and replace your wand whenever a better one turns up: it is half your damage before 20.
other: Discipline and Holy have their own leveling pages in this folder, for a priest who wants to arrive at 60 as a healer. Both are slower per kill.
After 40, Shadow is among the faster levelers in the fight lab. Before 20 every priest plays the same wand game.

keys.intro: Your two action bars, slot by slot: bar 1 is Q, E, R, F, Mouse 5, Mouse 4, 1, 2, 3, 4, C and the middle mouse button; bar 2 is the same keys with Shift, and Shift+X in the last slot. Keys are for spells you press in a fight and for the things that help you there; buffs, food, drink, the mount and the Hearthstone have no key, you click them between fights. The scheme is the same on every class: Q the attack you press most, E the control, R the payoff, F the escape or the save, the thumb buttons the reactions, 1-4 the rest, the middle mouse button the wand, the Shift bar the wider or rarer version of the key under it. A key keeps its job from 1 to 60 and only the spell on it changes. Bold marks what arrives in that stage. Free slots stay free until something earns them. Setup: the [priest keybinds page](keybinds.md).

slots.role: Control: fear what is on you
The panic heal, on a long cooldown
The wand: your filler before 20, the finisher after

bars.title: Action bar 2: the same keys with Shift

slots.role: Strip a mob's buff or your debuff

notes: One swap on bar 1: **Mind Flay** takes Q at 20 and **Smite** leaves the bar for good.
No key: **Power Word: Fortitude**, **Inner Fire**, **Shadowform** (a click once, it stays on), **Renew** (a between-fights heal before 40), food, water, the mount and the Hearthstone.
Levels 1-9 fight with Q, Mouse 4 and the middle mouse button. The wand is your filler until 20.
**Devouring Plague** and **Holy Fire** are never cast by the tuned rotation: no key.
